mapper.sql: COID, UID, CUID, Status, CreateTime, Remark
mapper.select: SELECT FROM usercollections WHERE UID = #{uid} AND CUID = #{cuid} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM usercollections WHERE UID = #{uid} AND Status = 1 ORDER BY CreateTime DESC

SELECT uc.COID, uc.UID, uc.CUID, uc.Status, uc.CreateTime, uc.Remark, c.CourseName AS courseName, c.CourseImage AS courseImage, c.Teacher AS teacher, c.LearnTime AS learnTime FROM usercollections uc INNER JOIN courses c ON uc.CUID = c.CUID AND c.Status = 1 WHERE uc.UID = #{uid} AND uc.Status = 1 ORDER BY uc.CreateTime DESC, uc.COID DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO usercollections (UID, CUID, Status) VALUES (#{uid}, #{cuid}, #{status})
